title: Four new largest known graphs of diameter three
description:
We present new largest known graphs for the degree-diameter problem at four degree-diameter pairs: graphs of diameter 3 and maximum degree 14, 18, 19 and 20, with 979, 1746, 1950 and 2202 vertices respectively, improving the previously recorded lower bounds of 916, 1620, 1638 and 1958. All four graphs are Cayley graphs of semidirect products of two cyclic groups Z_m ⋊_t Z_q and are given by explicit generating sets, so each record is verifiable by a single breadth-first search. The graphs were found by a stochastic search over generating sets, guided by an exact census of short-word relations in the candidate groups; all four are, in addition, near-optimal expanders.

This deposit contains the paper (PDF), full adjacency lists and standalone stdlib-Python verifiers for the four record graphs, (m,q,t,S) witnesses for all twenty graphs found during the campaign (including the sixteen intermediate improvements), and the LaTeX source with the script that regenerates every table directly from the witness files. See README.md for the ten-minute verification quickstart.
